## Decision

Owner: «Оставить действующие ключи до P2.5 и разрешить только их в P2.4; запрет импортов/прочих упоминаний сохранить». P2.4 permits only the existing exact Hocuspocus driver default and config lookup/key lines in packages/core/src/Support/Config.php and packages/core/config/vaulter.php. Exact counted allow-list; no blanket file exemption, imports, additional occurrences or prose exemptions. Existing runtime behavior remains until P2.5; no normalization is implemented in P2.4. Azgard and Filament names remain forbidden without exceptions. Code Guidance is zero unexpected matches under this exact allow-list.

## Rationale

P2.4 empty allow-list conflicts with live collaboration configuration and tested fallback; moving it now would execute future P2.5 scope. Owner resolved the specific acceptance conflict.
